fixed.what: render.mjs: throughput_per_h is now covered ids per WALL hour (R20 says 'per hour'); a step writes no ledger line while it works, so a ledger silence cannot be told from work. quiet_gaps, quiet_s and active_s stay as readings. null only when wall_s is 0 or there is no bind line. The transcript-timestamp option was not taken (larger spec change).
fixed.test_added: render.test.mjs T15b (bind and one line 2 h later: throughput 1.5, was null; one hour of silence plus 5 s: 3/(3605/3600), was 2160); T15 second case now expects 2.25 (was 9). Both fail with the old active_s division (mutation run).

fixed.what: seed.mjs certificatePool: one certificate per task (the latest by the ledger's 'certificate' line naming it; an id the ledger never names loses; ties go to the greater id). contra_k is counted only from sealed/plants/<task>.json of tasks that have a pooled certificate, so numerator and denominator cover the same set.
fixed.test_added: seed.test.mjs T18b: two certificates of one task pool once, the ledger order beats the id order, a planted task without certificate stays out of contra_k, contra_found <= contra_k, and the no-ledger tie-break. Fails under three separate mutations (contra_k filter removed, one-per-task removed, ledger order removed).

fixed.what: seed.mjs syntheticSentence now takes the batch rng: six phrasings carrying the same facts (approach, measure, value, unit) and a drawn sid s1..s12 instead of a constant text and sid 's1'. check-queue passes the same rng, so a batch stays reproducible. Limit: the text is still templated, not an authored sentence; a seed built from a real sentence would change what the checker is asked to verify, so it was not done.
fixed.test_added: seed.test.mjs T7b (phrasing and sid vary over 10 rng seeds, facts kept, same rng same sentence; T7 now matches /^s[0-9]+$/); check-queue.test.mjs T6b (the 8 seeded items of one freeze batch carry at least 3 phrasings and 2 sids).

fixed.what: audit.mjs coordinator form: each helper transcript is checked. A helper that read under queue/<b>/ is a checker; its reads are checked against tcb/profiles/checker.json read_prefixes with {batch} bound to the first batch it read (default '{root}/queue/{batch}/'); a helper with no batch read is flagged only for a read under sealed/. Offenders go to audit.checker_reads [{helper, path}], exit 1 with reason code 'tainted' (detail.checker_reads). Task form: a {batch} prefix now allows only the first batch read per transcript; a second batch is 'undeclared'. Limit: a helper's agent type is not in its own transcript, so 'checker' means 'read a batch'.
fixed.test_added: audit.test.mjs T14b (clean one batch; second batch; seed key after the batch; other file besides the batch; key alone; non-checker helper clean) and T3b (task form, second batch undeclared). Both fail with the new checks removed.
